videos.desc: A girl in a denim jacket stands in front of a torn-out photo of a lighthouse stuck on a wall and draws a circle on it with a marker, pointing at it. She is then on a train, looking out at the sea while holding the same photo. Finally she stands on a grassy clifftop at sunset and holds the photo up in front of her, lining it up with the real white lighthouse in front of her.

A girl sits on a train next to a poster of a red-and-white striped lighthouse taped to the partition and draws a circle around it with a marker, then rests her chin on her hands and looks at it. She is then standing on a grassy clifftop at sunset, holding the poster up towards the real lighthouse, and finally turns to look up at the tall red-and-white tower with the sun setting over the sea behind it.

A young man with headphones round his neck films himself in a window seat of an airliner. In the first shot the plane is racing along the ground past green fields and low houses outside the window and he grins into the camera as it lifts off. The shot cuts to cruising altitude at sunset: the wing and engine are lit orange above a floor of cloud, and he holds up a plastic cup of orange juice from the drinks trolley that a crew member is pushing past behind him. In the last shots it is night, and through the window a whole coastal city glows in orange lines of street lights far below as the plane descends; he turns from the window and claps his hands together with delight.

In a town of blue-painted houses a young local man in a striped robe leads a small group of tourists through narrow lanes, pointing things out and waving them on; they squeeze past a donkey pulling a wooden cart, walk under a blue archway and come out into a busy sunlit square.
videos.said: Follow me. Whoa, shh, low. Whoa, yes.

videos.desc: A young man in a wool jumper and rubber boots stands on a stone quay at sunrise with seagulls flying past. Behind him a small wooden boat is tied up on still water, then rows of white sailing yachts moored side by side; he runs his hand along a mooring line stretched from a yacht to the quay. Further along he leans on a rusty iron bollard with a thick rope coiled around it while a container ship is loaded by tall cranes and a tugboat crosses the water behind him.

A young man in swim shorts dives head first off the end of a wooden platform that runs out from the shore over a green lake, and hits the water with a big splash. He surfaces in the ring of foam, two more people plunge in, and then a long platform on posts over turquoise water appears, lined with dozens of teenagers who all jump off it together.

A line of people in matching gym kit hauls on a thick rope across a mown field, teeth gritted, dragging a wooden sled loaded with people, then an old saloon car. The scene cuts to an airfield where the same line of people pulls the rope hand over hand and drags a huge grey military transport plane, with four jet engines under its wings, along the tarmac towards the camera.

A garden party set-up on a mown lawn behind a wooden fence. First a colourful inflatable bouncy castle stands on the grass. Then a white party tent with window panels stands square on the lawn, its cloth roof stretched over a centre pole and weighted at the foot. A purple and yellow inflatable arch stands over the grass, then sags and folds flat as the air goes out of it, and a large inflatable slide collapses in the same way.

Two young men with big backpacks walk a narrow rough path cut through a spruce forest on a hillside. A selfie shot shows one of them breathing hard; the path behind him is loose dirt and stones. They laugh and point at each other, then climb on over a stretch of the path knotted with tree roots and rocks. At the end they stand on bare rock at the top, drop their packs, and throw their arms up over a wide green forest valley.

A woman in a white captain's cap, navy jacket and rubber boots walks up a metal gangway in a marina. She takes hold of the big wooden ship's wheel of a boat, with white yachts and masts behind her. A close-up shows her finger touching a brass compass set into the console, its needle and marked dial clearly visible. She pushes a throttle lever as the boat moves over the water, then points ahead over the bow.

A young man in a dark blue dress uniform walks out of the sliding doors of an airport arrivals hall with a large black duffel bag slung over his shoulder. He grins and looks around, walks through the bright glass concourse past waiting travellers, and reaches a family holding a hand-coloured WELCOME HOME sign. He hugs the father while the mother and a young woman laugh and cheer, then lifts his peaked cap off his head as they crowd around him.

At night outside a lit domed parliament building, an officer in white uniform raises a pale blue and yellow national flag up a white pole; the crowd below holds up matching flags and phone lights, fireworks fan out over the dome, and a young woman with her country's colours painted on both cheeks screams with delight in the middle of the flag-waving crowd.

A young traveller films himself in three places: first standing with arms thrown wide in front of a white marble domed mausoleum at the end of a long reflecting pool, then leaning grinning over cones of bright yellow, orange and red spice at a covered market stall, and finally in a street where people in white clothes hurl clouds of pink, yellow and green powder over each other, until his face and shirt are smeared with colour and he laughs into the lens.

A young woman in a hostel dorm with metal bunk beds tips a khaki backpack out onto the floor and rakes through the growing heap of clothes. She stands over the mess with her hands on her hips, mouth open in dismay, then kneels and searches under the bunk, shakes the empty backpack, and finally sits down on the bed holding her head, because whatever she is looking for is not there.

In a bright kitchen a young woman in a hijab loops a clear plastic ID tag onto the pulled-up handle of a black hard-shell suitcase, threads the strap and clicks it shut, then shows the card with her photo and name inside. The scene cuts to an airport baggage hall, where she waits by the carousel with her phone; a black case with a bright pink fluffy tag comes round and she pulls it off the belt.

A young woman with a straw tote bag walks away from the camera down a cobbled Mexican street strung overhead with rows of coloured paper banners. She then stands at a fruit market stall hung with bananas and stacked with oranges and limes and takes a large bite of a taco, pulling a delighted face. She climbs a wide flight of worn stone steps on an ancient ruin, and at the top she turns to the camera and throws both arms wide, with a huge stone pyramid rising out of green jungle behind her.

A young man in an orange rain jacket with a backpack films himself on a big city square in front of a brick church tower while pigeons take off around him, then at a wooden railing above a turquoise mountain lake ringed with rock walls, then at a wooden table in a restaurant where he lifts a spoonful from a plate piled with fried dumplings and eats with wide, delighted eyes.

Keys hang in the lock of a wooden front door. A girl with braided hair hauls a sticker-covered suitcase in over the threshold, pulls it past the fridge into the flat, and stops in the middle of the living room with her arms spread wide, grinning as she takes in the familiar rooms. She spins round barefoot on the rug and then drops backwards onto her own bed, arms flung out.

On a covered platform a boy holds a blank white sign above his head and a woman waits beside him with a bouquet, a red train standing at the platform edge and the rails running away past them. Passengers come out of the train and walk down the platform with their cases; a young woman in a denim jacket runs along the platform towards a man with a rucksack and jumps into his arms. The whole group closes around them in a hug, the flowers still in someone's hand.

A woman in a red headband stands at a trail map board in a pine forest and raises a finger as if fixing the way in her head, then runs along a dusty forest trail past a large pale boulder, places a stone on a cairn at the top, and finally stands at a viewpoint above a wide green valley holding an open map with a red line drawn on it.

Under the glass-and-iron roof of a station, a man in a beige trench coat with a green duffel bag runs down the platform beside a long dark green train while other travellers walk the other way with suitcases. He reaches an open door in the side of the train, grabs the frame and hauls himself in as it starts to move. The last shot is from the platform looking into the open doorway: he is standing inside the lit interior of the train, holding his bag against his chest and looking back out.

A young woman in an orange sailing jacket and a dark beanie is on the varnished wooden deck of a classic sailing boat crossing a fjord, with a big white sail above her and steep mountains on both sides. She hauls on a rope running through a wooden block, then leans over the side and cranks a metal winch as the boat picks up speed and throws a white wake behind it. She sits back at the rail with a coil of rope in her hands, looks out over the water, and finally punches a fist into the air and shouts while a second crew member steers at the wheel behind her.

The same three backpackers at the Grand Canyon railing, filmed closer. The woman calls out over the canyon, the bearded man lets out a roar while she points at him laughing, and then all three throw their arms and fists up in the air and whoop together over the view.

A woman in a green fleece stands on a country lane beside a weathered wooden post whose two arms read VILLAGE and LAKE, and she touches one arm as she reads it. Next she stands in a town square under a tall metal post covered in arms pointing to MUSEUMS, HARBOUR and OLD BRIDGE, looking up at them. Finally the same kind of post stands on a grassy clifftop above the sea and she throws both arms up beside it, holding a water bottle.

A young man with a backpack films himself from below as he climbs one staircase after another inside four different buildings: first a plain grey concrete stairwell, then a white spiral staircase, then a wooden staircase under a crystal chandelier, and finally a huge marble staircase covered in red carpet in a grand opera-house foyer. His eyes widen and his mouth opens further at every new staircase.

One traveller with a large red rucksack appears in three completely different parts of the world in a row. First he walks across the wide stone square in front of the Eiffel Tower in Paris under a blue sky. Then he is sitting in a long narrow boat under a striped canopy, riding through a floating market where sellers in conical hats hold trays of vegetables out of their boats, and he reaches over to one of them. Finally he is walking over flat white snow in a green sun hat, with icebergs on the horizon and penguins standing behind him.

A young traveller with a rucksack and a suitcase arrives at the carved wooden gate of a tropical guesthouse. A smiling woman in a batik dress lifts a chain of white flowers over his head and settles it on his shoulders while the hosts laugh around him. A man carries out a tray of green coconuts with straws and hands him one, which he takes gladly and drinks. The whole household lines the path clapping and cheering, arms in the air, as he walks through the gate holding the coconut and grinning at the camera.

A sunny market street in a foreign town with arched arcades and fruit stalls under faded awnings. A young red-haired woman with a big backpack, a loose linen shirt, trousers and brown boots stands in the middle holding a hand-drawn map, shading her eyes with one hand and looking lost. Two local men on either side point in opposite directions, one stepping closer as he points. At the end she breaks into a smile. A wheelbarrow and shoppers are behind her and dry hills rise beyond the rooftops.

The cabin of a private jet with walnut wood panels, a small lamp and a window where the sun sets over a sea of clouds. A young woman in a black blazer, burgundy top and black skirt sits in a cream leather seat and laughs, gesturing at the young man in the seat right next to hers. He wears a navy blazer, white shirt and beige chinos, holds a glass of sparkling drink, turns to her and bursts out laughing too, raising his hand. Only a shared armrest separates their seats.

A calm lake surrounded by pine forest in soft evening light. A young man with curly hair, in a blue linen shirt and cream shorts, sits in a silver aluminium canoe and paddles with a steel cooking pot tied to the end of a wooden pole instead of a paddle. He lifts the pot out of the lake and the water pours out of it, while a small wooden spoon floats away. Behind him a smiling young woman with blonde hair, in a yellow raincoat, holds a proper wooden paddle.

The cabin of a private jet with walnut panels, brass reading lamps, oval windows and a dark blue carpet. A young man with long hair tied back, in a navy jumper, cream trousers and white socks, lies stretched out full length in a wide cream leather seat that reclines into a bed. He laughs, spreads his arms wide, rolls over on the seat and stretches out again with his arms flung out, because there is so much room. A soft blanket hangs down from the seat to the floor.

On a sunny beach with rows of wooden sun loungers with blue striped cushions under terracotta umbrellas, a young woman in a white shirt over a burgundy swimsuit leaps through the air with her legs spread, flinging her straw hat, towards the one empty lounger. She lands in the sand beside it, then stretches out on the lounger and lies back. The other loungers are taken by towels, hats and bags, and a golden retriever sleeps on the next one. A young man in blue swim shorts and a young woman in a beige swimsuit watch. The sea glitters behind.

Seen from the back of an open safari jeep, a driver's hands rest on a padded roll bar. Ahead, a kudu antelope with long spiral horns and white stripes on its brown coat walks across the sandy track, kicking up a little dust, then stops at the edge and turns its head. Wild land of thorny shrubs, low green trees and a red termite mound stretches to the horizon with no buildings, a dry sandy riverbed winds through it, and heavy grey clouds fill the sky.

A laughing young woman in a yellow raincoat, a striped top, rolled jeans and a straw hat rides a bicycle along a wet stone causeway, holding her hat on with one hand. Her wheels splash through sea water as she rides, and waves break on both sides. Behind her a big old grey stone abbey church with a tall square bell tower, arched windows and slate roofs stands on a rocky island with a green walled garden. Gulls fly under a heavy grey sky.
